Thinking

The Sivence method / Signal + Evidence

From a business question
to a marketing decision.

A framework for connecting customer and channel evidence with a clear campaign priority, accountable delivery and a defined review point.

01

Business question

Define the decision.

Start with the change the business needs. Is the priority qualified demand, brand clarity, adoption, retention or delivery? Define the audience and time horizon before selecting a channel.

02

Signal map

Collect what the market is saying.

Bring together customer questions, search behavior, sales feedback, CRM patterns, competitor movement and channel performance. A signal is an observation to investigate.

03

Evidence check

Test what holds up.

Compare sources, recency and relevance. Look for corroboration, identify contradictions and name the information that is missing.

04

Strategic choice

Choose the priority.

Select the audience problem and campaign priority. Make the reasoning visible, identify assumptions and clarify ownership.

05

Bounded test

Connect message, channel and experience.

Set the message, route to market, customer experience, owner and review window. Make the test focused enough to learn from and complete enough to expose friction.

06

Review

Keep, change or stop.

Read the outcome against the original objective. Keep what is supported, change what the evidence challenges and stop work that no longer earns its place.
